coupons.what: R 0.1 tension-tension fatigue, PPA-CF printed on the owner's H2S (H1 profile: 0.6 hardened nozzle, 290 C, bed 110 C, chamber 65 C, 100 % infill), conditioned 14 d at 23 C / 50 % RH
coupons.coupons: 6 Z-built (load across the layers, the H1-P governing direction) + 6 XY-built, ISO 527-2 1A shape, plus 3 static of each from the same plate for the batch UTS
coupons.load: Smax = 0.279 x the batch's own conditioned mean UTS, 1e5 cycles at <= 5 Hz, 23 C
coupons.pass: all 6 Z-built and all 6 XY-built run out to 1e5 cycles at Smax / UTS = 0.279 (= fatigue ratio 0.30 / H1-P cinch-cycled margin 1.076)

coupons.what: Z tensile (ISO 527-2 1A, printed standing: load across the layers) and interlayer shear (short-beam shear, ASTM D2344 4:1 bar printed flat so the mid-plane is a layer interface), dry (as printed, sealed with desiccant, tested within 24 h) and conditioned (14 d at 23 C / 50 % RH)
coupons.coupons: 6 Z tensile + 6 SBS dry; 6 + 6 conditioned; same spool, same H2S profile as the frame
coupons.pass: (a) conditioned Z tensile mean - 2.4 SD >= 31.3 MPa (H1-P needs knocked Z 32.85 / 1.051); (b) conditioned SBS mean - 2.4 SD >= 18.8 MPa (0.6 x (a), ASSUMPTION INTERLAYER-0.6); (c) for the record: dry Z mean >= 45 MPa and conditioned / dry >= 0.73 means the design values hold as booked
coupons.if_below: between 31.3 and 0.9 x that: R1 reads 0.9-1.0, hold the PPA build and add the hot-spot growth of the next H1-P step; below: stay on PAHT-CF
coupons.if_below_corrected: (review 8 m-4, corrected) with a measured knocked Z_m: R1 = 1.076 x Z_m / 32.85 and z 234 joint fatigue = 1.051 x Z_m / 32.85; at 28 MPa they read 0.917 / 0.896. Below 31.3 MPa hold the PPA build (superseded by BL-073 CA-3-HW)

coupons.what: 3-point bend modulus and strength (ISO 178, XY-built bars 80 x 10 x 4), at 23 C dry, at 40 C after 14 d at 23 C / 50 % RH ('40 C wet'), and at 60 C dry (truck cab)
coupons.pass: E(40 C wet) / E(23 C dry) >= 0.85 (the booked ratio; the H1-P buckling margin 3.72 alone would allow 0.23); E(60 C) / E(23 C) >= 0.75 (record); flexural strength at 60 C >= 0.73 x 208 = 152 MPa

coupons.what: -20 C drop of a printed stay coupon: the H1-P lower stay z 0-240 (R side) cut from the lower-half file (foot, hinge eye, US1 lug root), printed in PPA-CF with the frame profile, a 2.0 kg steel slug pinned through the hinge eye (half the empty pack, 4.04 kg)
coupons.coupons: 3 PPA-CF + 1 PAHT-CF control; soaked >= 4 h at -20 C, dropped within 60 s of removal
coupons.load: 1.22 m (48 in, HA-LS-1 T4c) onto 19 mm plywood over concrete, foot first, then side-on (about 24 J each)
coupons.pass: no crack or whitening (10x loupe, dye penetrant on the foot and the eye), tap test clean, and the coupon then carries 3-point bend at 1.5 x its C4 set-down stay moment without a crack; any Z crack (along a layer) is a fail
coupons.settles: COLD (impact_minus20c_ratio 0.5; Z Charpy 4.3 kJ/m2 vs PAHT 13.3)
coupons.margin_tied: not in the FI check (impact); this is the PPA risk BL-069 flagged

assumptions.text: Design Z 45 MPa (57 - 2.4 SD) x wet knock 0.73 (Raise3D conditioned / Bambu dry).
fatigue_1e5_ratio 0.30 (PA12-CF lower bound), on the layer rule's FI.
Interlayer shear strength = 0.6 x Z tensile (frame_topopt layer rule, as PAHT).
Where interlayer shear governs (92 % of the R1 top 1 %), a margin scales with knock x Z.
assumptions.settled_by: re-run check_body with the coupon values

assumptions.text: Voxel FE isotropic at E_xy (the stress fields are unit-modulus, so strength checks do not depend on it); buckling at E_xy x 0.85 hot x 0.85 creep = 8526 MPa. Layer-normal bound x E_z / E_xy = 0.364.
assumptions.settled_by: CA-4-PPA (40 C wet, 60 C); T1 deflection at 150 lb

assumptions.text: z 234 joint and US2 clevis capacities on the PPA joint dict: washer / contact bearing on knock x XY, plug shear-out and clevis hole bearing on knock x Z; contact stiffness E x 0.85.
Insert pull-out on PPA either by the record rule (hot x Z/XY TDS ratio 0.339: 297 N) or by the PAHT HB-6 basis scaled by knocked Z (448 N); both fail the 8-insert fatigue row (needs 488 N).
assumptions.settled_by: HB-6-PPA only if inserts are kept

assumptions.text: H1-P hip mount through-bolts: nut / D10 washer bearing on the layers in compression taken at knock x design Z (32.9 MPa) on the ring D10 / D5.5; tipping model and rigid flange as BL-055 (FLANGE-RIGID).
assumptions.settled_by: HB-6b on the frame (hip mount proof) with the through-bolts

assumptions.text: H1-P moves material only on the 2 mm voxel model of the released print: interfaces, crown sleeves, member floors, lash points and the wearer (plate) face frozen; thinning one surface layer at a time where the PPA utilisation (6 mm max filter) is low, growth where it is high.
Print time by the BL-053 rule (8 mm3/s x 1.08) at the PAHT volume rate; TDS speed < 100 mm/s.
PPA-CF (E x 3, crystallises at 178 C) warps more than PAHT on a small plate contact; chamber pre-heat 30 min at 65 C, glue, brim 15 mm, mouse ears at the stay feet.
A half that needs > 0.75 kg is started on a full dried spool with a second dried spool staged (AMS feed of PPA-CF on the H2S not verified).

coupons_bl073.replaces: CA-1-PPA (review 8 M-3; the XY / Z tension fatigue bars are dropped: their static pulls exceed the 100 kg cell, BL-071)
coupons_bl073.what: short-beam-shear FATIGUE (the governing interlayer mode, shear_xy): ASTM D2344 bars 18 x 6 x 3, span 12, mid-plane on a layer interface, cut from a solid block printed on the H2S with the frame profile beside a dummy tower sized so every layer takes >= 181 s (the median layer time of a frame half by the BL-053 rule, LAYER-H 0.3 mm); log the layer time of each batch from the slicer preview; conditioned to constant mass at 50 C over saturated NaCl (74.4 % RH, Greenspan 1977; above the TDS 55 % RH, so conservative): weigh daily, done when the mass changes < 0.1 % in 24 h (ISO 62 practice); record the uptake against the TDS 1.30 %; tested at 40 +/- 2 C, R 0.1, <= 5 Hz
coupons_bl073.coupons: 6 SBS fatigue + 3 SBS static from the same block (the layer-normal share, 7 % of the R1 top 1 %, is covered by the CA-3-HW Z bars)
coupons_bl073.load: Smax (shear) = 1.15 x 4.80 = 5.52 MPa, i.e. peak load 132 N (30 lbf) on the SBS jig (tau = 0.75 P / (b h)); 4.80 MPa = 0.30 x interlayer 14.88 MPa / governing fatigue margin 0.930
coupons_bl073.pass: all 6 run out to 1e5 cycles at 1.15 x Smax (life factor by load: the 1.15 load factor on a Basquin slope of about 10 is about a factor 4 on life, review 8 M-3); the 3 static SBS >= the CA-3-HW SBS line
coupons_bl073.settles: FAT-PPA (0.30) in the governing shear mode, hot/wet

coupons_bl073.what: Z tensile (ISO 527-2 type 1BA, 5 x 2 mm gauge, cut from the block so the gauge crosses the layers) and SBS (ASTM D2344 proportions at t 3), cut from a solid block printed on the H2S with the frame profile beside a dummy tower sized so every layer takes >= 181 s (the median layer time of a frame half by the BL-053 rule, LAYER-H 0.3 mm); log the layer time of each batch from the slicer preview; hot/wet set conditioned to constant mass at 50 C over saturated NaCl (74.4 % RH, Greenspan 1977; above the TDS 55 % RH, so conservative): weigh daily, done when the mass changes < 0.1 % in 24 h (ISO 62 practice); record the uptake against the TDS 1.30 %, tested at 40 +/- 2 C; dry set as printed (sealed, tested within 24 h at 23 C); plus 6 SBS with a planned 20 min pause at the mid-plane layer (the spool-change layer, M-6)
coupons_bl073.coupons: hot/wet: 10 Z + 10 SBS; dry: 6 Z + 6 SBS; pause-layer: 6 SBS (hot/wet)
coupons_bl073.statistic: B-basis = mean - k SD, k 2.355 at n 10 (one-sided 90/95 normal tolerance factor, CMH-17-1G Vol 1 8.3.4.3 / NIST e-Handbook 7.2.6.3)
coupons_bl073.pass: (a) hot/wet Z B-basis >= 23.7 MPa (= 24.80 / 1.048, the interlayer-governed rows R1 and z 234 joint fatigue); (b) hot/wet SBS B-basis >= 14.2 MPa (0.6 x (a)); (c) pause-layer SBS mean >= 0.9 x the no-pause hot/wet SBS mean and its B-basis >= (b); (d) for the record: uptake, hot/wet / dry Z (booked 0.73 x 0.85 = 0.621 on the B-basis)
coupons_bl073.settles: WET-PPA 0.73, HOT-40 0.85, B-basis Z 39.97, INTERLAYER-0.6, the pause layer
coupons_bl073.if_below: with a measured hot/wet B-basis Z_m: R1 = 1.048 x Z_m / 24.80, z 234 joint fatigue = 1.072 x Z_m / 24.80 (LINEAR-Z); below 23.7 MPa hold the build and grow the hot spot by the shortfall

coupons_bl073.what: ISO 178 3-point bend, XY bars 80 x 10 x 4: 23 C dry; 40 C conditioned to constant mass at 50 C over saturated NaCl (74.4 % RH, Greenspan 1977; above the TDS 55 % RH, so conservative); 60 C dry
coupons_bl073.pass: (a) modulus, mean of 5: E(40 C conditioned) / E(23 C dry) >= 0.50 (the governing need: buckling 3.10 at the booked 0.588 and the z 234 joint contact stiffness, re-run at E_hot 0.50 in the tornado); (b) flexural strength at 60 C dry, mean - 3.41 SD (n 5) >= 143 MPa (hot ratio 60 / 20 C 0.688, Fiberlogy; for the record, no row rests on it)

assumptions_bl073.text: The Bambu TDS +/- values are standard deviations of an ISO 527 set of n = 5 (the ISO 527-1 minimum; the TDS gives no n): B-basis k 3.4066.
Hot ratio of wet PPA-CF at 40 C = 0.85, the lowest of the Fiberlogy 40 / 20 C UTS ratio (0.864) and its Tg-shift readings (0.852-0.886) with the wet Tg 51-67 C.
20 wt % carbon fibre (matrix fraction 0.8) for the water-in-matrix reading.
assumptions_bl073.settled_by: not governing (the composite-basis reading is lower and taken)

assumptions_bl073.text: Hot/wet modulus = Raise3D conditioned / Bambu dry 0.661 x Fiberlogy E 40 / 20 C 0.889 = 0.5876 (was 0.85).
Hip nut load spread by the 2 mm 6061 ring as a beam on a Winkler foundation (k0 = E_z / boss depth, cold E_z x 1.25), group of 4 at the 28 deg pitch; the larger of that peak and the ring average.
assumptions_bl073.settled_by: HB-6b hip-mount proof on the first H1-P frame

assumptions_bl073.text: Nut factor 0.20, scatter 0.14-0.26, for the Ti screw in an A2 nut with Loctite 243; the creep row uses the high preload (K 0.14), the closure check the low one (K 0.26).
Long-term layer-normal creep modulus of the boss at 40 C wet = 0.5 x short term (no curve published; 8 h is 0.85).
PPA-CF across the layers 60e-6 / K (not in the TDS): at -20 C the hip nuts lose their preload; no row credits preload, Loctite 243 holds the nuts.
0.30 mm layers (Bambu Studio 0.6 nozzle standard) for the layer-time and the swap layer.
60 g of each 750 g spool kept back for purge and net-weight tolerance.
Sacrificial pads (D24 x 0.6 foot, D12 column, D6 -> D3 neck fused 0.6 mm into the part) hold the far ends of each half on the plate and snap off; the neck scar is sanded.
z 234 bolts moved to (18.5, 6) / (-19, 5.5) local: checked on the BL-070 g1 cut sections for the choice, then on the exported body.
assumptions_bl073.settled_by: the checks on the export; CA-5 z 234 stub coupons
